messages.subject: For Rachelle Girard | Corporate affairs, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Baker,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Rachelle Girard, Senior Vice President and Chief Corporate Officer.

Cameco's position across uranium, nuclear fuel services and strategic partnerships makes government, institutional and community relationships integral to long-term growth. That country-facing interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I routinely coordinate external commitments across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a conversation about where this experience might support Cameco's corporate-affairs, government-relations, stakeholder or international-growth priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
